q.line: To break the bonds of tyranny
stanza: John Lewis stood on the Pettus Bridge
His life he was ready to give
To break the bonds of tyranny
And live a life with dignity
They marched straight into a sea of blue
To a great warrior of love

partner.line: His life he was ready to give

q.line: And he's moving through the winds of tyranny
q.linePrev: Oh, well, he's moving through the flames of anarchy
q.lineNext: And the sweet, sweet tears of liberty
